versionScheme.description: Schema used to validate the version; use `custom` to opt out of validation

icon.description: Symbol that is used as heading prefix in the generated changelog

placeholder.description: Placeholder text that is shown as hint in the `picco add` command

pullRequest.description: Setting to show or hide an additional prompt for a pull request number in the `picco add` command

presets.description: List of preset texts that are displayed as options for the summary prompt in the `picco add` command. This allows users to quickly select common texts instead of typing them manually.

allowBreaking.description: Whether changes of this category can be breaking
